name: Berserk
description: Guts, a wandering mercenary, joins the Band of the Hawk after being defeated in a duel by Griffith, the group's leader and founder. Together, they dominate every battle, but something menacing lurks in the shadows.

videos.title: The Black Swordsman
videos.overview: A blacksmith is forging an enormous sword while a dark man with only one eye and one arm stands back and watches.

videos.title: Band of the Hawk
videos.overview: There is a great battle taking place at a fort. The attackers are doing well, except one thing stands in their way -  a grey knight and he states that none shall pass him.

videos.title: First Battle
videos.overview: Guts and Griffith begin their sword fight.

videos.title: The Hand of God
videos.overview: Guts reminisces about his childhood.

videos.title: A Wind of Swords
videos.overview: Guts is now a commander of Griffith's army, taking many risks in battle, Casca takes him to task for it. Griffith is knighted in the Midland court much to the nobles' dismay.

videos.title: Zodd the Immortal
videos.overview: In another raid, Guts and Griffith come across a demon known as Nosferatu Zodd.

videos.title: The Sword`s Owner
videos.overview: Princess Charlotte of Midland strikes up a friendship with Griffith.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: Griffith and Guts continue their success in battle and Griffith is made a Count.

videos.title: Assassination
videos.overview: Griffith saves Charlotte when her horse bolts during a fox hunt. Yurius, the king's younger brother, attempts to have him assassinated.

videos.title: Nobleman
videos.overview: Guts, sent by Griffith, assassinates Yurius and his son Adonis. Griffith gets closer to Charlotte. The Hawks depart for yet another mission.

videos.title: The Battle
videos.overview: On a stormy battlefield, Casca, Griffith's second in command, is wounded while fighting the leader of an enemy army. Guts runs to her rescue but when she passes out at the edge of a cliff, he cannot catch her in time and they both fall into the river below.

videos.title: Together
videos.overview: Casca is still unconscious, so Guts shelters them in a cave while the rain pours down. She comes to and tells Guts about her past and about Griffith's.

videos.title: Prepared for Death
videos.overview: Guts and Casca try to fight their way back to the Hawks while the enemy army they were fighting from before try to stop them.

videos.title: Bonfire of Dreams
videos.overview: Casca finds Judeau's division of Hawks and leads them back to where Guts was fighting alone. Although injured, he defeated all the enemy soldiers by himself. They return to the Hawks' camp and Casca tends to Guts' wounds.

videos.title: The Decisive Battle
videos.overview: The King of Midland and his various generals confer about Doldrey Castle, long since captured by the Chudan Empire. Griffith plans an attack and the King agrees despite the protests of his other officers. Only one other general supports Griffith's actions. The Hawks attack Doldrey.

videos.title: The Conqueror
videos.overview: With the help of Nosferatu Zodd, Guts defeats the defender of Doldrey Castle.

videos.title: Moment of Glory
videos.overview: With the victory at Doldrey, Griffith is promoted to White Phoenix General, an aristocratic title. The Queen of Midland and other court conspirators try to poison Griffith.

videos.title: Tombstone of Flames
videos.overview: Griffith has his revenge by having the Queen's castle burned down.

videos.title: Separation
videos.overview: Griffith will not let Guts simply leave. He says that Guts belongs to him.

videos.title: Sparks
videos.overview: Guts arrives at the home of Godo the swordsmith and stays there for a while while Godo crafts a new sword for him. Guts practices more on his sword techniques with the help of Godo's little daughter Erika.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: Guts returns in time to save the remaining Hawks from annihilation.

videos.title: Infiltration
videos.overview: With Guts help, Casca and the Hawks hope to rescue Griffith.

videos.title: Eve of the Feast
videos.overview: Breaking away from the King's pursuing armies, the few Hawks left contemplate their future. Guts comforts Casca, who is despondent over Griffith's condition. Griffith begins to dream.

videos.title: The Great Eclipse
videos.overview: Seduced by the promises of demons and his dreams from his childhood, Griffith agrees to fulfill his destiny and become one of the God Hand demons.

videos.title: Time of Eternity
videos.overview: Griffith's men are sacrificed to the demon's appetites. Guts fights on, at first to save Griffith, then to save himself from the result of Griffith's ambition.
